_comment: 2016 counterpart of dijet_data_2018_minimal_rho_pairsplit.json. Systematics-grade minimal_rho dijet DATA production on the 2026-08-06 pair_split fiducial. The systematic profile is left at minimal_syst because it is a no-op on data: the jetsyst loop skips every non-nominal entry when do_gen is False, and the data weights object carries no variations, so data is nominal-only by construction whatever the profile says. Also carries the per-jet kinematic validation hists, which is the point of the run -- they are the data leg of the per-year pair_split kinematic data/MC ratios. JetHT Run2016F(-UL2016), G, H (postVFP), 147 files. Era plumbing for 2016: JEC Summer19UL16_V7_MC / Summer19UL16_RunFGH_V7_DATA, JER Summer20UL16_JRV3_MC, lumi 16.8 fb^-1, golden JSON Cert_271036-284044_13TeV_Legacy2016_Collisions16_JSON.txt, prescales/ps_weight_JSON_2016.json. The fileset qualifier that selects this era's datasets is set by notebook_utils.HADRONIC_ERAS_DATA; the processor re-derives the same IOV from the DAS name, so nothing here needs an explicit IOV key.
